entries.04b5271da38da6c9: It develops, manufactures and sells liquid filling film that wraps liquid soup for instant noodles, dressings, sauces, wasabi, soy sauce and the like, as well as general-purpose laminated products for powders and dried goods and for toiletry and cosmetic-related products. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥28,381 million.
entries.30c8418761e1c8cf: As the only company providing both liquid packaging films and liquid filling machines, it is pursuing solutions that balance reduced environmental impact with productivity and functionality, with development challenges including environmentally friendly films made from new materials and compatibility with filling machines.
entries.33b2c872a8dfca5a: It combines high-performance films tailored to customer needs, such as leak prevention, preservation and ease of opening, with the “DANGAN” liquid filling machine that fills the contents into the film, and proposes comprehensive solutions to packaging risks.
entries.3c9326ff7b425dd3: It sells high-performance packaging films suited to contents and uses, together with the “DANGAN” liquid filling machine, which fills liquid and viscous seasonings and other products into film, and supports the packaging processes of food manufacturers and others.
entries.48ac4bfe4e93498a: Liquid-filling films (laminate films for packaging liquid soup for instant noodles, dressings, sauces, wasabi, soy sauce, etc.)
entries.4c7de1f81ca38983: In its existing domestic business, it will focus on the liquid pouch packaging field, working to provide higher value-added products and services, optimize selling prices and thoroughly reduce costs, while overseas it will concentrate resources in its existing regions to expand its business base. It also plans to create new services related to liquid packaging, research new packaging fields, and reduce environmental impact.
entries.502e7cf4e7a56ce9: This is a single-segment business that mainly serves the food industry and integrates the development, manufacture and sale of packaging film with the development, manufacture, sale and maintenance of liquid filling machines.
